whenToUse: An independent garage, car wash or detailing shop with a price list by car size and online booking.
Service businesses where the ready-by time and price must update as the customer picks jobs.
avoidWhen: A clinic-style appointment booking — use site-clinic-01.
a11y: The ready-by time and price are announced through aria-live; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
The three-step booking uses grouped fields — keep each step's labels visible.
